stem: A technician scouts a quarantined group and then needs to enter an unaffected room. What should happen first?
choices: Follow the required exit/changeover sanitation procedure before entering the unaffected room
Enter quickly before contaminants can transfer
Carry scouting tools directly into the next room
Skip documentation so the quarantine visit stays confidential
rationale: Quarantine only reduces risk when movement out of the area is controlled through the defined changeover process.
